description: Contrast case for tracks_occlusion.json: a track that has NEVER been confirmed/reported before misses a single frame during its own startup window. Unlike a previously-confirmed track recovering from occlusion (see tracks_occlusion.json), this track must re-earn min_hits consecutive successful updates from scratch before it is reported for the first time -- proving the Lost-track-reactivation shortcut applies only to tracks that already established identity once, not to genuinely new tracks. 3 leading empty frames push the tracker's global frame_count past min_hits (3) BEFORE this track spawns, so the SORT startup exception (frame_count <= min_hits) does not apply to it either -- only its own hits count can confirm it.
